podcast.title: DIY Pioneer
podcast.body: Embodying the punk ethos, Jordan herself cut, tore, and added safety pins to garments. She then dressed the Sex Pistols in these modified clothes for their early performances, marking the aesthetic birth of the movement. "Jordan Solf había cortado las prendas, había rotas prendas, les había puesto los imperdibles y ella habría vestido a sitvicios y a todos los 6 pistos en sus primeros conciertos dando así lugar al nacimiento estético del movimiento punk."

podcast.title: Early Personal Style
podcast.body: Before her role in defining the punk aesthetic, Jordan describes her own early fashion choices, often involving frilly party dresses that would get tangled during games. "Sometimes about seven really, I used to wear those party dresses that you always get caught out when you're playing hide and seek in air frills and things and I was used to get caught and you get caught out."

podcast.title: Final Definition of Punk Aesthetic
podcast.body: Jordan is credited with providing the final impetus and definition to the punk aesthetic movement. She took the ideas from Vivienne Westwood and Malcolm McLaren (which originated from Richard Hell) and, through her DIY approach, solidified the iconic look. "Ella le daría el escoletazo final al movimiento estético del punk."

podcast.title: First Modern Aesthetic Punk
podcast.body: She is considered possibly the first modern punk aesthetically as we know it, taking the imported ideas and transforming them into a definitive style. "Ella fue la verdaderamente posilmente la primera punk moderna estéticamente tal y como la conocemos."

podcast.title: Personal Friend of Sex Pistols
podcast.body: She was a personal friend of the Sex Pistols even before they achieved fame, which gave her direct influence on their image. "Era amiga personal de los 6 pistos antes y que franfamosos."

podcast.title: Sex Pistols Stylist
podcast.body: Jordan personally dressed, applied makeup to, and styled all members of the Sex Pistols for their concerts. Numerous interviews, backstage footage, and photographs show her actively working on the band's look. "Fue la que acabó vistiendo, maquillando y peinando a todos los 6 pistos en sus conciertos. Tenemos un montón de entrevistas de conciertos de backstage de fotografías de los 6 pistos en los que vemos a esta chica Jordan maquillando y vistiendo a los 6 pistos."

podcast.title: Shop "6" Assistant
podcast.body: Jordan worked as a shop assistant at Vivienne Westwood and Malcolm McLaren's shop "6" in central London. Her position put her at the heart of the burgeoning punk fashion scene. "Jordan que es esta chica que era la dependienta de la tienda 6 de Vivian Westwood."
